pictures.scene: Durer, The Seven Angels with the Trumpets — a woodcut of God enthroned in a blaze of rays above the clouds while winged angels on either side lift long straight trumpets to their mouths and fire falls on the sea and the burning city far below, then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_seven_angels_with_the_trumpets

pictures.scene: Wright of Derby, A Cavern near Naples — the black mouth of a sea cave arching over an empty shore and opening on a pale bay with a lone watchtower and a mountain beyond, and it was given the key to the pit of the abyss, the star opened the pit of the abyss
pictures.name: pd_wright_of_derby_a_cavern_near_naples

pictures.scene: Hubert Robert, The Fire of Rome — a wall of flame roaring through the arch of a stone bridge and swallowing the buildings beyond while a seated statue stands black against the smoke and people flee down the steps carrying a child, and smoke rose out of it like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke
pictures.name: pd_robert_fire_in_rome

pictures.scene: Turner, The Fifth Plague of Egypt — a vast black storm boiling over a white pyramid and a pale city, the whole sky turned to smoke and the bare trees below left in shadow, and out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth, and they were given power like that of scorpions
pictures.name: pd_turner_plague

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Harvesters — a field of standing wheat half cut into sheaves, reapers bending to the sickle while others eat bread and porridge in the shade of a heavy pear tree and one man sleeps against its trunk, they were told not to harm the grass of the earth, or any plant or tree
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_harvesters

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Knights of Christ — armoured riders filing out of a rock pass on a white horse and a dark one, red banners and a shield marked with the cross carried above crowned and turbaned heads, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_knights_of_christ

pictures.scene: Munch, The Sick Child — a red haired girl propped against a white pillow with her head turned toward a dark bowed figure who holds her hand at the bedside, the locusts were not given power to kill them, but only to torment them for five months
pictures.name: pd_munch_the_sick_child

pictures.scene: Bosch, Christ Crowned with Thorns — Christ in a crown of thorns hemmed in by four tormentors, one in a green turban laying a hand on his shoulder and one in an oak leaf cap pressing close against his face, and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion, in those days men will seek death and will not find it
pictures.name: pd_bosch_christ_crowned_with_thorns

pictures.scene: Philippe de Champaigne, Still Life with a Skull — a bare skull set alone on a pale stone ledge against black with a single cut tulip at the edge of the shelf, they will long to die, but death will escape them, and the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle
pictures.name: pd_champaigne_still_life_with_a_skull

pictures.scene: Circle of Rembrandt, The Man with the Golden Helmet — an old bearded man under an embossed gold helmet with a feather plume, a steel gorget at his throat and his lowered face lit from the left out of the dark, with something like crowns of gold on their heads, and faces like the faces of men
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_circle_the_man_with_the_golden_helmet

pictures.scene: Stubbs, Horse Frightened by a Lion — a pale horse recoiling against a dark rock with its long white mane and tail streaming out behind it and its mouth open in alarm, they had hair like that of women, and teeth like those of lions
pictures.name: pd_stubbs_horse_frightened_by_a_lion

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Man in Armour — a helmeted figure seen in profile under a gold plume, a steel breastplate buckled over a red cloak and a long staff held upright in his hand, they also had thoraxes like breastplates of iron, and the sound of their wings was like the roar
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_man_armour

pictures.scene: Van Huchtenburgh, Cavalry Battle — a rider on a black horse swinging a sabre under a red banner with fallen men and horses heaped in front of him and a thicket of lances and smoke beyond, of many horses and chariots rushing into battle, they had tails with stingers like scorpions
pictures.name: pd_van_huchtenburgh_cavalry_battle

pictures.scene: John Martin, Belshazzars Feast — a banqueting hall laid with gold vessels where the whole crowd recoils and a dark robed prophet points while a ziggurat looms under the storm, which had the power to injure people for five months, they were ruled by a king, the angel of the abyss
pictures.name: pd_martin_belshazzars_feast

pictures.scene: Bruegel, The Tower of Babel — a spiralling tower of brick and arches built half into the clouds with stonecutters kneeling at their blocks in the foreground and a red robed figure standing at the far left edge, his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek it is Apollyon
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_babel

pictures.scene: Bendemann, Jews Mourning in Exile — a bearded old man in red robes with a shackle chain at his wrist and a harp lying across his lap, a fair haired woman weeping against his knee, the first woe has passed, behold, two woes are still to follow
pictures.name: pd_bendemann_jews_mourning_in_exile

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Angels Playing Music — crowned angels in heavy gold embroidered robes gathered at a pipe organ, one bent over the keys and others behind her with a harp and a viol, then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_angels_playing_music

pictures.scene: An altar at dusk — a stone altar standing on a raised platform with fire burning on its top and smoke lifting straight into the darkening sky, no one near it, of the golden altar before God, saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet
pictures.name: altar_fire

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saint Peter in Prison — an old bearded man sitting on the straw of a dark cell with his hands clasped in his lap and two heavy keys lying on the ground beside him, release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_saint_peter_in_prison

pictures.scene: Bruegel, Hunters in the Snow — three hunters seen from behind with their spears and their dogs coming down a snowy hill above a valley of frozen ponds and a fire burning by the inn at the left, so the four angels who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_hunters_in_the_snow

pictures.scene: Vereshchagin, The Apotheosis of War — a pyramid of bare skulls heaped on a dry plain with crows wheeling around it and settling on the bone, were released to kill a third of mankind, and the number of mounted troops was two hundred million
pictures.name: pd_vereshchagin_the_apotheosis_of_war

pictures.scene: Uccello, The Battle of San Romano — armoured knights on a white charger lowering their lances over a ground strewn with broken lances while hares and hounds run through the fields behind, I heard their number, now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this
pictures.name: pd_uccello_the_battle_of_san_romano

pictures.scene: Wright of Derby, An Iron Forge — a bar of white hot iron lying on the anvil under the tilt hammer with a smith in a red waistcoat bent over it, a young man watching with folded arms and a woman holding a child, the whole shed lit orange, the riders had breastplates the colors of fire, and sapphire, and sulfur
pictures.name: pd_wright_an_iron_forge

pictures.scene: Delacroix, Lion Hunt — a roaring lion standing over a fallen hunter while a second lion climbs onto the back of a horse and turbaned riders drive in with their lances, the heads of the horses were like the heads of lions, and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur
pictures.name: pd_delacroix_lion

pictures.scene: John Martin, The Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah — a city buried under a vast curtain of fire and black smoke with one small white robed figure left standing on the dark ridge, a third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur from their mouths
pictures.name: pd_john_martin_the_destruction_of_sodom_and_gomorrah

pictures.scene: Stubbs, A Lion Attacking a Horse — a lion fastened on the back of a white horse that screams and twists away under dark cliffs, for the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails, indeed, their tails were like snakes
pictures.name: pd_stubbs_a_lion_attacking_a_horse

pictures.scene: Snayers, Battle on Vught Heath — a cavalry skirmish across pale heath with black helmeted riders in armour closing on each other, a horse down and a sword dropped in the grass and a windmill and skaters far behind, having heads with which to inflict harm, now the rest of mankind who were not killed
pictures.name: pd_snayers_battle_on_vught_heath

pictures.scene: Steen, Beware of Luxury — a woman in black raising a finger at a seated man who goes on reading while a pig noses the scraps, a hat and cards and pretzels lying on the floor and a monkey stopping the clock above the hearth, still did not repent of the works of their hands, they did not stop worshiping demons and idols
pictures.name: pd_steen_beware_of_luxury

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Daniel and Cyrus before the Idol Bel — a crowned king in a turban and a gold embroidered cloak holding out a golden sceptre toward a dim idol on its column while a bowing figure with clasped hands stands at the left, of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_idol_bel

pictures.scene: Bosch, The Conjurer — a gaping man bent low over a bare table at the cup and the ball with a key swinging from his belt, a crowd pressed in behind him and a man in white at the edge quietly lifting what hangs at his side, furthermore, they did not repent of their murder, sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft
pictures.name: pd_bosch_the_conjurer

lines.text: Then the fifth angel sounded his trumpet,
and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth,
and it was given the key to the pit of the Abyss.
The star opened the pit of the Abyss,
and smoke rose out of it like the smoke of a great furnace,
and the sun and the air were darkened by the smoke.
And out of the smoke, locusts descended on the earth,
and they were given power like that of scorpions.
They were told not to harm the grass of the earth,
or any plant or tree,
but only those who did not have the seal of God
on their foreheads.
The locusts were not given power to kill them,
but only to torment them for five months,
and their torment was like the stinging of a scorpion.
In those days men will seek death and will not find it;
they will long to die, but death will escape them.
And the locusts looked like horses prepared for battle,
with something like crowns of gold on their heads,
and faces like the faces of men.
They had hair like that of women,
and teeth like those of lions.
They also had thoraxes like breastplates of iron,
and the sound of their wings was like the roar
of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
They had tails with stingers like scorpions,
which had the power to injure people for five months.
They were ruled by a king, the angel of the Abyss.
His name in Hebrew is Abaddon,
and in Greek it is Apollyon.
The first woe has passed.
Behold, two woes are still to follow.
Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet,
and I heard a voice from the four horns
of the golden altar before God,
saying to the sixth angel with the trumpet,
Release the four angels who are bound
at the great river Euphrates.
So the four angels who had been prepared
for this hour and day and month and year
were released to kill a third of mankind.
And the number of mounted troops was two hundred million;
I heard their number.
Now the horses and riders in my vision looked like this:
The riders had breastplates the colors of fire,
and sapphire, and sulfur.
The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions,
and out of their mouths proceeded fire, smoke, and sulfur.
A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues
of fire, smoke, and sulfur from their mouths.
For the power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails;
indeed, their tails were like snakes,
having heads with which to inflict harm.
Now the rest of mankind who were not killed
still did not repent of the works of their hands.
They did not stop worshiping demons and idols
of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood,
which cannot see or hear or walk.
Furthermore, they did not repent of their murder,
sorcery, sexual immorality, and theft.
